notes: Commencement date taken from the date of the Offer to Purchase (June 29, 2021); the excerpt says withdrawal after offer expiry runs from August 25, 2021, 40 business days from commencement, but does not state the commencement date as such. The asset-coverage condition is coded as other. Trigger: the Board approved the offer on March 9, 2021 conditioned on shareholder approval of a new advisory agreement after Morgan Stanley acquired Eaton Vance Corp.; that condition was met at the May 7, 2021 meeting; coded other. Cover page of the Schedule TO states NAV $13.6727 (June 23, 2021); the Offer to Purchase body is inconsistent about that NAV ($13.24 appears as NAV in the Introduction and Section 1, where it is the closing price in the summary); no NAV value is extracted.
